status: Full 20-article study: 400 slots attempted, 399 nonempty replies, 292 valid tagged bodies; both conditions reclassified with the same free checkpoint. No human quality validation.
purpose: Focus the intervention on recurring AI prose while leaving the angle, voice, length, structure and ending to the writer.

design_choices.style_guidance: One expanded constraints section covers formatting, paragraph rhythm, negative and additive contrasts, stock openings and transitions, generic benefits, word choice, noun-heavy wording, staged revelations, mechanical sentence shapes, trailing significance clauses, redundant hedging, formulaic endings, invented experience and punctuation tics.
design_choices.revision: The 15-constraint candidate was frozen before the Kimi-only pilot; the earlier shorter candidate remains in Git history.
design_choices.writer_judgment: No prescribed angle, word count, paragraph count, ending, source-auditing procedure or final-check procedure.
design_choices.followups: Explicitly request another independent standalone post from the same article, rather than a continuation, revision or critique of earlier drafts.
design_choices.boundary: Request one linkedin_post tag pair around the post and discourage additional text before or after it.

planned_output_handling.status: Implemented for preview and full study; strict format failures retained separately.
planned_output_handling.valid_post: Exactly one complete, non-nested <linkedin_post>...</linkedin_post> pair containing nonempty post text.
planned_output_handling.extra_material: Preserve text before and after the tags without discarding the response. Track it as output-format noncompliance separately from whether the enclosed post is readable.
planned_output_handling.classification: Strict comparison uses only the exact enclosed body. A separately declared sensitivity classifies exact nonempty invalid-tag raw replies, preserving input type and excluding them from strict rates.
planned_output_handling.format_failure: Missing, empty, malformed, nested or multiple post tag pairs are unreadable format outcomes; do not silently guess the body or regenerate based on content.
planned_output_handling.historical_data: Do not apply the new tag contract to earlier untagged responses.

planned_conversation_design.initial_turn: A new conversation for each model/article block, containing the initial template and complete frozen article text.
planned_conversation_design.subsequent_turns: Resume that block using exactly the saved follow-up template.
planned_conversation_design.independence_limit: Independent describes the requested standalone post. Prior drafts remain in the conversation, so the generations are not statistically independent.
planned_conversation_design.isolation: Keep conversations separate from baseline and plain-prose-v2 and from other articles or models.
planned_conversation_design.settings: Retain high writer effort and CLI-only access with tools and web search disabled.

limitations: Prompt, continuation and output contract change together; conditions were collected at different times using undated writer aliases.
The prompt and taxonomy were chosen after baseline inspection; matching Kimi preview outputs are reused rather than held out.
Many free-classifier contextual categories are near a floor; controls are small and no human labels calibrate probabilities.
Missing tags select the strict population. Raw sensitivity preserves malformed output, not an inferred post body. One capacity-interrupted block has its own sensitivity.
model_call_counting_note: All expanded-condition writer calls (20 preview + 380 extension), full primary classifier attempts, 119 historical pilot API attempts, and two full-route diagnostic controls. Baseline and intermediate paid runs retain separate historical ledgers.
